Module predicate_manager

The module defines a container datatype PredicateManager, used to store instantiated predicates.

The instance of any predicate class (subclass of GeoPredicate) needs to be registered in a predicate manager with an unique name, in order to be used to populate the corresponding PiSPEC paramter(s).

By default, all instantiated predicates from builtins are registered upon the instantiation of PredicateManager.

Classes
  PredicateManager
A predicate manager is used to maintain a collection of registered names and the associated predicate instances.

Imports: builtins, TypeManager, typedoc, geoAssert, IRailyard
